payload.name: Aluminium Tapes
payload.description: Aluminium tapes for insulation, sealing and construction, including cold-weather, IMO-certified and reinforced options.

payload.name: Construction Tapes
payload.description: Professional construction tapes, including filament, insulation, duct, masking and double-sided tapes.

payload.name: Foils & Jacketing
payload.description: Aluminium foils, reinforced foils and weatherproof jacketing for insulation and protective cladding.

payload.name: Cardboard Edge Protectors
payload.description: Cardboard corner and edge protectors to help protect and stabilise palletised loads.

payload.name: Strapping Bands
payload.description: PP, PET, paper and polyester strapping products for bundling and securing packages.

payload.name: Stretch & Wrapping Film
payload.description: Hand and machine stretch films, bubble wrap and pallet top sheets for packaging and load protection.

payload.name: Spray Adhesive
payload.description: High-tack spray adhesive for fast, permanent bonding.

payload.name: Aluminium Tape – Cold Weather
payload.short_description: Vapour-tight aluminium tape with cold-weather acrylic adhesive for insulation and sealing.
payload.description: Suitable for sealing insulation blankets, spiral ducts and flue gas ducts. Features strong adhesion, a cold-weather acrylic adhesive and DIN 4102 B1 classification. Available pack sizes: 50 mm × 45 m (24 rolls), 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (16 rolls).

payload.name: ISOHULK Aluminium Tape AW IMO
payload.short_description: IMO/MED-certified premium aluminium tape with strong cold-weather adhesion.
payload.description: Designed for demanding marine insulation and sealing applications. Flame-retardant aluminium tape with aggressive cold-weather adhesive; TPS Pack states temperature resistance from −40°C to +140°C. Available in 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (12 rolls).

payload.name: ISOHULK Aluminium Tracing Tape IMO
payload.short_description: Marine-grade, glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tracing tape with strong adhesion.
payload.description: Glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tape described by TPS Pack as IMO/MED-certified for marine use. Available in 50 mm × 50 m, 75 mm × 50 m and 100 mm × 50 m formats. Confirm current pack quantities before ordering.

payload.name: Aluminium Butyl Waterproof Repair Tape
payload.short_description: Water-resistant and vapour-tight butyl repair tape for sealing joints and connections.
payload.description: Heavy-adhesive butyl tape for sealing seams, closures, frames, roofs and façades. Designed for waterproof repair and sealing applications. Available in 50 mm × 15 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 15 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 15 m (12 rolls).

payload.name: PP-Coated Aluminium Tape
payload.short_description: PP-aluminium tape for joining laminate foil and sealing insulation materials.
payload.description: Premium polypropylene-aluminium tape with an aluminium coating, suitable for use in both cool and warm conditions. Intended for joining laminate foils and sealing insulation materials. Available as 50, 75 and 100 mm wide × 100 m rolls in webshop pack formats; TPS Pack also lists 50 m lengths elsewhere.

payload.name: Black Aluminium Tape AW
payload.short_description: Black cold-weather aluminium tape for a neat finish on dark insulation.
payload.description: Strong-adhesion black aluminium tape for sealing and finishing insulation materials. TPS Pack lists cold-weather acrylic adhesive and DIN 4102 B1 classification. Available as 50, 75 and 100 mm wide × 50 m rolls.

payload.name: Length-Reinforced Filament Tape
payload.short_description: Glass-fibre-reinforced filament tape for securing and sealing heavy packaging.
payload.description: Length-reinforced filament tape designed for strong packaging and bundling applications. The glass fibres increase tear resistance. Available in widths of 19, 25, 38, 50, 75 and 100 mm, each on 50 m rolls, with pack quantities listed per option.

payload.name: Machine Stretch Film Power 250% – 500 mm × 2000 m × 17 µm
payload.short_description: Clear machine stretch film, 17 µm thick, with 250% stretch.
payload.description: Machine-grade clear pallet wrapping film. Roll dimensions: 500 mm width × 2000 m length; thickness 17 µm and a stated stretch level of 250%. Packaging and order quantities vary.

payload.name: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1800 m × 20 µm
payload.short_description: Clear machine stretch film, 20 µm thick, with 300% stretch.
payload.description: Machine stretch wrap for securing palletised goods. Roll dimensions: 500 mm × 1800 m; film thickness 20 µm and a stated stretch level of 300%. Available in different order quantities.

payload.name: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm
payload.short_description: Clear machine stretch film, 23 µm thick, with 300% stretch.
payload.description: Machine wrapping film intended to stabilise pallet loads. Roll dimensions: 500 mm × 1500 m; thickness 23 µm and a stated stretch level of 300%. Available in different order quantities.

payload.name: Cardboard Edge Protectors – Pack of 50
payload.short_description: Cardboard corner protectors for pallet and package edge protection.
payload.description: Pack of 50 cardboard edge protectors used to protect exposed corners and reinforce palletised loads. TPS Pack also offers corner profiles in a range of widths, lengths and thicknesses; confirm the exact dimensions of this pack before ordering.

payload.name: ISOHULK Aluminium FSK Tape IMO
payload.short_description: IMO/MED-certified aluminium FSK tape for cold-weather insulation applications.
payload.description: Premium fibre-reinforced aluminium FSK tape with aggressive cold-weather adhesive. TPS Pack specifies IMO/MED certification and operating temperature resistance from −40°C to +120°C. Available in several dimensions and thicknesses.

payload.name: High-Temperature Aluminium Tape – 300°C
payload.short_description: Vapour-tight aluminium tape with heat-resistant adhesive rated up to 300°C.
payload.description: Designed to seal insulation blankets, spiral ducts and flue gas ducts in high-temperature settings. TPS Pack lists heat resistance up to 300°C and DIN 4102 A1 classification. Different widths and thicknesses are available.

payload.name: Reinforced Aluminium Tape
payload.short_description: Tear-resistant aluminium tape reinforced lengthwise and crosswise.
payload.description: Aluminium sealing tape for insulation blankets and ductwork. Lengthwise and crosswise reinforcement improves tear resistance, while the cold-weather acrylic adhesive supports application at lower temperatures.

payload.name: Elastomeric Arma Foam Insulation Tape
payload.short_description: Self-adhesive foam insulation tape for finishing insulated pipes and ducts.
payload.description: Self-adhesive elastomeric foam tape for use with Armaflex-type pipe and duct insulation. Designed to help reduce condensation. Specified size: 3 mm thickness × 50 mm width × 15 m length.

payload.name: Glass Cloth Marine Tape GM3
payload.short_description: IMO-certified glass cloth tape for marine insulation work.
payload.description: Glass cloth tape used to seal glass-fibre insulation in marine environments. TPS Pack describes IMO certification and good performance at elevated temperatures.

payload.name: Double-Sided Foam Tape
payload.short_description: Strong, water-resistant double-sided foam tape for mounting and sealing.
payload.description: White foam tape with pressure-sensitive adhesive on both sides. TPS Pack states operating temperature suitability from −30°C to +80°C, strong adhesion and good water resistance. Available in multiple thicknesses.

payload.name: Blue Marine Masking Tape – 14-Day UV
payload.short_description: Flexible blue masking tape with 14-day UV resistance.
payload.description: Blue crepe-paper masking tape with resistance to water and solvents, intended for modern paint systems. TPS Pack specifies UV resistance for up to 14 days and temperature resistance up to 110°C.
